mapper.insert: INSERT INTO events ( title, category, description, start_at, end_at, user_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{request.title}, #{request.category}, #{request.description}, #{request.startDate}, #{request.endDate}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW() )

mapper.select: SELECT event_id AS eventId, title, category, description, DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%Y%m%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(end_at, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS endDateExclusive, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(updated_at, '+09:00', '+00:00'), '%Y%m%dT%H%i%sZ') AS dtstamp FROM events WHERE state = 'normal' ORDER BY start_at ASC, event_id ASC
